blurb: Guests experience a scenic cruise aboard the General Jackson Showboat with live performances of country, bluegrass, and rock 'n' roll music. Cruises include a midday lunch cruise with live entertainment and Southern flavors, and an evening dinner cruise with live music and a Southern-style meal. The boat offers panoramic views of the Cumberland River and the Nashville skyline.
